amcm.insertion: last bottleneck module, before original decoder
amcm.token_policy: encoder-configured CLS/register prefix unchanged; only 28x28 patches processed

initialization: Independent fresh pretrained encoder and seed1 reconstruction/AMCM. Never initialize from Bridge V1 or either trained V0.
input: 512 full frame resized to 392; no spatial crop

validation.checkpoint_selection: maximum image AUROC; tie pixel AP
validation.threshold_selection: maximum validation image F1 per corresponding checkpoint

test.usage: after complete training, best validation checkpoint and reference final

evaluation: unchanged historical 256 evaluator and 14-damage-label union; later corrected evaluator must re-evaluate V0 and V1 together
independent_checks: No smoke, subset training or short-run selection; full-run guards retained
gpu_policy: After completed Bridge, wait for GPU0 free >=14500 MiB; never stop another job
publication_gate: Dedicated updated plan commit and published codex/v1-amcm-dacl ref before launch; model/execution code identical to Bridge publication commit. Clean immutable server checkout, same implementation; no tuning or retries.
